divisions.prepTryNote: Lumenary Prep is paid. These lessons are free samples of its courses.
divisions.subjectsLead: Each subject starts from first steps and climbs to the frontier. All of them are free and open source, and every lesson is a first draft awaiting review by a human expert.
divisions.mathematicsText: From counting to graduate school, taught through intuition, formal proof and computation.
divisions.statisticsText: From averages and charts to Bayesian computation, causal inference and the statistics of AI.
divisions.computerScienceText: From a first program to algorithms, systems at scale and the frontier of AI.
divisions.programmingLanguagesText: A course for each major language, from Assembly to Zig, with every program run.
divisions.electricalEngineeringText: From a first circuit to chips, radios, power grids and quantum hardware.
divisions.roboticsText: From a first moving robot to control, perception, planning and robot learning.
divisions.chemistryText: From atoms and reactions to quantum chemistry, synthesis and the molecules of today's research.
divisions.mechanicalEngineeringText: From forces and machines to thermodynamics, fluids, design and manufacturing.
divisions.materialsScienceText: From atoms and crystals to metals, polymers, semiconductors and materials found with AI.
